moments.text: Digital recreation fades in from black: a rocky desert ridge on the left, a cactus near its foot, under a deep blue sky with faint specks.
A small orange light glows up right of centre, then fades out.
It keeps returning in pulses, at 0:07, 0:11, 0:15 and 0:20, each time larger, a round glossy orange shape, fading out in between.
The orange shape comes back at its largest and now stays lit.
Small red lights appear at its right side and step outward to the right in a short row.
The orange shape dims and turns see-through, fading away by about 0:45, while a row of three red lights keeps stepping right.
The three red lights move on in small jumps toward the right edge; the last one leaves at 0:53.

notes: Digital recreation (FBI, 2026), not original footage. Review tool's old auto-crop 1920:850:0:0 (live has no crop; tool fixed) trims the dark brush foreground (there are no black bars).
